pinout_notes: Dedicated FB pin (tied to OUT internally) beside -IN for short feedback routing; +IN physically separated from -VS for better HD2 ('low-distortion pinout'). PD (active low) must not float; tie to +VS if unused; power-down when PD < +VS - 3 V, enabled when PD > +VS - 1 V (Table 8: +/-5 V: >4 V enabled, <2 V off).

tia_content.what: Wideband photodiode preamplifier design equations (Fig 50 circuit, Fig 51 noise model): VOUT = IPHOTO RF/(1 + s CF RF); f(45 deg) = sqrt(fCR/(2 pi RF (CS + CM + CD))); CF = sqrt((CS + CM + CD)/(2 pi RF fCR)); larger CF reduces peaking

tia_content.measured_or_simulated: calculated: RF 94 uV, VEN 777.5 uV, IEN 0.4 uV, total 783 uV rms

tia_content.what: Photodiode preamplifier frequency response (Fig 52); G = 63 V/V, RL = 100 Ohm, VS = 10 V, VOUT = 6 V p-p

application_guidance: Feedback resistor 100-400 Ohm recommended (p15). CF 0.5-2 pF across RF reduces peaking; Fig 46 (ADA4817-2, G = 2, RF = 348 Ohm, 10 V, RL = 100 Ohm): no CF ~2.2 dB peaking at ~250 MHz, CF = 0.5 pF ~1.3 dB, CF = 1 pF flat (-3 dB ~390 MHz). A series RS at +IN forms a pole with CIN (SOIC, G = 1: RS 0 -> 100 Ohm cuts peaking ~2 dB, BW 1 GHz -> 700 MHz); RLC network (10 nH + 2 pF in series, in parallel with 120 Ohm) at +IN gives 1 GHz BW, 250 MHz 0.1 dB flatness, <1 dB peaking (p16 Figs 47-49). Capacitive loads: RSNUB 10-50 Ohm. Text p20: the architecture does not require balancing the two inputs; for best noise minimise the impedance from +IN to ground. Layout p17-18: remove ground/power plane under input and output pins, 0.1 uF 0508 + 10 uF bypass, keep at least 7 mil between the inputs, guard ring for leakage.
abs_max_and_input_protection: Supply 10.6 V; common-mode input -VS - 0.5 V to +VS + 0.5 V; differential input +/-VS; junction 150 C (175 C long-term failure risk); storage -65 to +125 C; operating -40 to +105 C; ESD-sensitive (no HBM value given). Source p5 Table 3.
other_notes: Chinese-language Rev. A. Figure numbering error: the DC-error figure on p14 repeats the caption 'Fig 43' (should be Fig 44). In Table 1/2 the power-down row labels are offset one line from their values (turn-on/off 0.3/1 us at +/-5 V; PD-pin leakage 0.3/3 uA and 34/61 uA). GBW is printed '>=410 MHz' in the TYP column. Fig 28 and Fig 18 do not print their configuration/load (TPC defaults assumed). Fig 46 arrow labels are ambiguous; 600 dpi zoom shows the 'NO CF' arrow on the highest-peaking curve, as expected physically.
